name: Weinstadt (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, black and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Weinstadt (yellow grapes below an antler on black).
history: Municipal flag of Weinstadt; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weinstadt arms — grapes and antler on black
